terms.comment: Our modern descriptive phrase. The photographed yellow DeWalt item matches the DT70620 shear attachment: it mounts on a drill or impact driver; the long arm stabilizes it. No reference work names the tool. Accessōrium is not in Lewis & Short, and Traupman’s attachment, appendicula (p. 260), is what is attached to an e-mail.

sources: DeWalt DT70620: tool identification
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260.
